text: A line returns on 2 or more spreads in 3 of 5 books ('It's not me, Mama. It's Mud!', 'Catch that cat!', 'No, Amahle, you are too young.'); the other 2 repeat a failed-attempt structure instead of a line. Evidence: 3 of 5 works, small sample, confidence LOW. Proposal for `writing_guidance`: Distinguish deliberate refrains (a line the listener can join, changed once at the end) from accidental repetition before treating all repetition as a defect.
